changed: Retain nearest S2 AND nearest Landsat before/after each fixed date-support, rather than S2 only
justification: Independent timing-versus-spatial-support tradeoff. Saved metadata shows nearer Landsat opportunities for some cases and coarse/uncertain registration; S2 supplies finer detail. Both are inspected, rather than choosing a favourable provider after content.
source_ranking: Within each provider/side: nearest absolute acquisition offset, footprint covers target point, tie by item ID; no cloud/water/content ranking
Landsat_limitation: 30m native information and tier/registration uncertainty retained. Posting on10m indexing grid creates no new information.
scene_class_percentages: Internal raw metadata only; not selection factors, response truth or reader-packet fields
